metadata.title: Further constraints on simultaneous totient and divisor-sum jumps of length 12: the form n=p^2q
metadata.description:
Version 1.5 (23 November 2026). This is a new version of concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22713135. Version 1.3 remains the 12 November 2026 deposit.

The vanishing conjecture for n = p^2q is not proved. Hypotheses H2 and H3 remain open. The elliptic packaging of residual R2 is not a closure.

What was re-checked on 16 November 2026:

  • RCW.R2TwistFibers, Lean 4.14.0, Mathlib revision 4bbdccd. lake build printed Built RCW.R2TwistFibers and Build completed successfully. The two theorems exclude integer points on the twist fibers with 5 ≤ r and 1 ≤ |d| ≤ (r − 3)/2. That is not Hypothesis R2.
  • P2qTheorem28, Lean 4.22.0, Mathlib revision 79e94a09. Built P2qTheorem28.Theorem28. Build completed successfully.
  • P2qStructural, P2qTheoremD, and P2qExtensions, same toolchain. Build completed successfully. One linter warning at P2qStructural/Basic.lean:116.
  • Every named declaration printed by #print axioms depends only on propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound.

The file p2q-jumps-v1.5.pdf is 51 pages: the v0.11-review2 paper, then the kernel re-check, then the Lean sources. The logs deposited beside it are the captured tails of those runs, not a full Mathlib trace.

Rejected drafts are not certificates: the imports Mathlib.Data.Int.Basic and Mathlib.Tactic.Nlinarith do not exist at that Mathlib revision; linarith failed on the undoubled gap; a later edit corrupted the import to Nnnlinarith.

Lean sources are Apache-2.0. This deposit is CC BY 4.0. Author responsible for every theorem, computation, and error: Benjamin Stanley Frohman. ORCID 0009-0006-7068-3718.
